description: A utility class providing helper methods for working with entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. Includes functions for filtering, sorting, retrieving related entities, handling date-based filters, and constructing entity path representations.

classes.name: EntityUtil
classes.description: Final class providing static utility methods for entity operations.

methods.name: makeFields
methods.description: Creates a map of field name to value pairs from a variable argument list, validating types.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first GenericValue from a collection or list of GenericValues.

methods.name: getOnly
methods.description: Returns the only GenericValue from a collection or list, or throws an exception if more than one is present.

methods.name: getFilterByDateExpr
methods.description: Returns an EntityCondition for filtering by date ranges based on 'fromDate' and 'thruDate'.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters a list of GenericEntity objects to those active at the current time or a specific timestamp.

methods.name: isValueActive
methods.description: Determines if a specific GenericValue is active at a given timestamp based on 'fromDate' and 'thruDate'.

methods.name: filterByAnd
methods.description: Filters a list of entities to those matching all provided field conditions or entity conditions.

methods.name: filterByOr
methods.description: Filters a list of entities to those matching any of the provided conditions.

methods.name: localizedOrderBy
methods.description: Orders a collection of entities according to specified fields, considering locale for localized values.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Sorts a collection of entities based on specified order fields.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities via a specified relationship name, optionally with filters and caching.

methods.name: filterByCondition
methods.description: Filters entities that match a particular EntityCondition.

methods.name: filterOutByCondition
methods.description: Filters entities that do not match a particular EntityCondition.

methods.name: findDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Finds entities with date ranges including the current timestamp.

methods.name: newDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Creates or updates a dated inclusion entity with current or specified dates.

methods.name: delDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Marks a dated inclusion entity as ended by setting its 'thruDate'.

methods.name: getFieldListFromEntityList
methods.description: Extracts a list of specific field values from a list of GenericValue entities.

methods.name: getFieldListFromEntityListIterator
methods.description: Extracts a list of specific field values from an EntityListIterator.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldValueListFromEntityList
methods.description: Returns entities with only selected fields

methods.name: isMultiTenantEnabled
methods.description: Checks if multi-tenancy is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getStartIndexFromViewIndex
methods.description: Calculates the starting index for paging based on view index and size.

methods.name: getPagedList
methods.description: Returns a PagedList of entities for a given iterator, page index, and size.

methods.name: entityToPath
methods.description: Constructs a URL path String representing the entity's primary key values.

methods.name: getPkValuesMapFromPath
methods.description: Parses a URL path string to extract primary key values into a Map.
